title.en: Read what a device says about itself: capabilities, safety limits, conformance, recalls

goal.en: The four GET endpoints of the Core API answer before any cooking: what the device can do, which limits it enforces locally, what it claims to conform to, and which recipe revisions are recalled.

note.en: The reference hub simulates the example robot arm: three operations and one vision sensor.
The draft default limits pack: fourteen limits, the first one cuts heat when frying oil passes 200 degC.
The hub declares the executor class itself; it has no third-party report, and says so.
No recall is in force for the hub.

outcome.en: You know the shape of a capability document and a SafetyLimits pack, and that the disclaimer in the pack asks makers to replace it with limits from their own safety case. Next: scenario 006 lists the demo devices and the operation vocabulary.
